name: Water's Edge
source: A traumatic incident in his childhood has left Mizutani Nagisa with an irrational fear of water. When storms afflict the neighborhood he stays in for a full week, his occasional nightmares begin to plague him every single night -- until one day he finds himself stranded in his school building, which is slowly filling up with water...
translation: 童年时的一场创伤事件，让水谷渚患上了毫无道理可言的恐水症。当暴风雨连续一周侵袭他居住的地区后，原本偶尔出现的噩梦开始夜夜纠缠着他——直到某一天，他发现自己被困在校舍里，水位正缓缓上涨……
